propositions: Markdown structure (headings, checklists, code, lists) authored in rebar appears as literal source in Jira Cloud and Data Center instead of native rich-text formatting.
Rich text authored in Jira Cloud (ADF) and Data Center (wiki markup) reads as noise when synced back to rebar, and repeated passes cause content erosion through codec round-tripping.
The current plain-text ADF encoder and identity wiki codec lack echo-safety mechanisms to prevent sync loops that ratchet Jira-specific formatting back into the store.
Concurrent edits on both Cloud and DC sides can be silently overwritten without detection or flagging of the conflict.
Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates) authored in Jira are not preserved when a subsequent rebar-originated reconcile pass re-encodes the body.
The rendered HTML output in Jira Data Center (via ?expand=renderedFields) is not tested against the wiki-markup codec fidelity, only the raw wiki source.
